title: Independent semantic backcheck — Tshivenda and Xitsonga introduction candidates
scope: Read-only independent semantic backcheck of 61 VE/TS proposals. No repository edits, commits, pushes, or translated audio actions.
method: For every candidate, compare sourceEnglish to the current matching slide/body in the paired VE or TS introduction JSON and to the canonical English narration. Backtranslate candidate clauses for meaning and flag omissions, shifts, directional errors, land/soil ambiguity, wrong-language carryover, numbers, conditions and causal chains. Keep machine review distinct from fluent-speaker approval.
